svg.title: Deterministic native Chaos suite - required evidence and verdicts
svg.desc: Independent verdicts for complete baseline, exact-instance process crash, zone-selected process crash, PostgreSQL failover, combined overlap and genuine infrastructure-zone loss. On the Windows comparison variant, 6 November 2026: BASE-001, HA-APP-001, HA-APP-ZONE-001, HA-DB-001 and HA-COMBINED-001 passed recovery and durability; database and combined full-phase availability failed separately at about 97.3 percent; HA-AZ-001 remains blocked. Linux App Service rejects native process deletion. All 92616 acknowledged measurement writes across 31 runs were retained with checksums.
svg.text: Deterministic native Chaos suite - evidence contract
Windows comparison variant, 6 November: five required cases PASS; HA-AZ-001 BLOCKED. Linux app cases BLOCKED.
Mandatory readiness gate before every fault
Actual six workers / three physical zones / all-instance health and business traffic / private app and SCM
Owned native targets; healthy private PostgreSQL HA; failover cooldown >= 20 min; one bounded, attributable load.
BASE-001
5 min warmup + 10 min baseline; success >= 99.9%; p95 <= 1 s.
Capture health/traffic identity, every issued operation, canary and acknowledged-write reconciliation.
HA-APP-001
Native Kill process; exact nonempty InstanceIds selection; prove actual PID/start-time change. Windows PASS.
Observe >= 5 min after effect; success >= 99%; p95 <= 2 s; complete-unavailability gap <= 5 s.
HA-APP-ZONE-001
Native Kill process with verified Zones selection and actual physical/logical mapping. Windows PASS.
Evidence covers selected-zone instance effects and unaffected zones; apply app-only thresholds.
HA-DB-001
Windows run: native failover PASS; recovery 36.359 s; primary/standby zones swapped.
Full-phase availability FAIL: 97.347%; retention PASS: 5,348 phase writes, zero acknowledged loss.
HA-COMBINED-001
Windows run PASS: process replacement bracketed by observed DB failures; recovery 34.989 s.
Full-phase availability FAIL: 97.324%. Concurrent submissions alone provide no overlap evidence.
For each phase: availability + recovery + durability remain separate verdicts
Errors / drops / latency / recovery; resolve every issued write; zero lost acknowledgements, duplicates or checksum mismatches.
Preserve raw clocks, instance/PID evidence, Action state, DB state and complete post-recovery observations.
HA-AZ-001: BLOCKED without qualifying correlated infrastructure-zone outage evidence
Discrete process crashes establish process-fault behavior. A sustained real-zone outage needs its own injection and observation.
All Linux and Windows runs: 92,616/92,616 acknowledged writes retained across 31 runs. Linux stays the baseline; Linux app cases BLOCKED.
